caption: The worked example: 1000 copies of ρ with eigenvalues 0.9 and 0.1 compress to 469 qubits instead of 1000, because the typical subspace has about 2^469 dimensions; decoding gives fidelity near 1.

spec.title: Schumacher: worked example
spec.aria: In the worked example, 1000 copies of a state with eigenvalues 0.9 and 0.1 are projected into a typical subspace of dimension about 2^469, stored in 469 qubits, and decoded back to 1000 copies with fidelity near 1.
